# Green Chili Indian Restaurant

> Green Chili Indian Restaurant is located at 1501 Lyons Road in Dayton, OH, offering traditional Indian cuisine such as curries, tandoori specialties, biryanis, and fresh naan bread. The restaurant also features a popular lunch buffet that includes both vegetarian and non-vegetarian selections.

## Menu
Offers a wide range of traditional Indian dishes including various curries, tandoori specialties, biryanis, and fresh naan bread. Features a popular lunch buffet with vegetarian and non-vegetarian selections.
